author: PeanutButter91
quote: What a game. The only other game I have every completed is BOTW and I have to say that this game blew me away completely. From the story, to the atmospheric dungeons and areas. The game is amazing from start to finish. While I don't think its a perfect game I give it a 10/10 here because my real score would be about a 9.8. Which of course isn't possible. So I might as well round up for my new favorite game of all time.
